criteria.description: Scope, authority, and dependencies are explicit.
criteria.limitations: Repository-local reversible implementation and disposable test infrastructure are authorized; production changes, provider commitments, credential rotation and release remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The implementation plan, tasks, and risks are executable.
criteria.limitations: The planned database function, shared-session synchronization and rate-limiter design remain hypotheses until rejecting tests and real PostgreSQL/Redis observations validate them.

criteria.description: Acceptance and verification are defined before implementation.
criteria.limitations: No acceptance criterion is currently verified; the gate authorizes TDD implementation only and cannot support a security, parity, production or release claim.

authority.decision: No separate human authority is required for reversible changes in this repository and disposable synthetic test environments.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before external-system mutation, credential handling, production deployment or release acceptance.
